coverage.evidence: grid_complement.mjs reruns the lane's own gridStates/instrument/p9Grid over the 5 missing viewport x theme x language cells (175 cell-states, 0 violations) and a coarse-pointer arm at 44 px (lane never passes coarse=true); pipe_hit.mjs hit-tests the layout-editor pipes across 12 cells. Tab order, console errors, hover layout shift, reduced-motion-off and screenshots not done.

unfinished.what: Keyboard tab order through every focusable, console-error sweep, layout shift on hover, the reduced-motion-off arm (CELLS=motion is defined but was not run), screenshots; also the run used Chromium 131 (rev 1148), not the lock's rev 1194

findings.title: Layout-editor pipes (click to remove) are 1.25-5.75 px hit targets under every pointer
findings.claim: In the setup page's layout_editing state, every drawn pipe's hit-tested band is 1.25-5.75 px, so 30/30 pipes under a fine pointer are below the card's 24 px floor and 30/30 under pointer:coarse are below its 44 px floor.

evidence.value: pipes_under_44_coarse=30, pipes_under_24_fine=30, band_max=5.75 px of 60 pipes
evidence.machine: macOS arm64 B9, Chromium 131 headless shell rev 1148
evidence.contention_note: shared box, other seats running; geometry counts are contention-immune

perturbation.change: PIPE_STROKE=30: in-memory rewrite of the editing rule 'stroke-width: 3.5' to 30
perturbation.expected_direction: band_max rises (5.75 -> 52.75 px); under-24 falls 30 -> 14; under-44 falls 30 -> 23

findings.metric_definition: Per pipe, the width in CSS px of the band along the pipe's normal at its midpoint over which shadowRoot.elementFromPoint returns an element whose closest [data-edge] is that pipe; counted below 24 px (fine) or 44 px (coarse).
findings.phenomenon_property: Every click target drawn as an SVG stroke in the layout editor must hit-test at least the card's own floor (24 px; 44 px with a coarse pointer).
findings.seam_rule: grep -n 'class="setup-pipe' custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/www/heatpump-optimizer-card.js; the lane's instrument().targets() measures the bbox, so a straight pipe (bbox width <0.5 px) is filtered out and a curved one reads as 60x10.7
findings.proposed_fix_scope: Give every editable pipe a transparent wide hit stroke carrying the same data-edge, sized from _targetMinPx(); extend the lane's target rule to hit-test stroked paths

non_findings.claim: The 5 viewport x theme x language cells the lane does not run show no contrast, overflow, popup, small-target or listbox violations
non_findings.value: 175 cell-states, 0 contrast, 0 overflow, 0 popups, 0 small, 0 options, 0 threw

non_findings.claim: The card's coarse 44 px floor holds for HTML targets; without the spacing exception only the pipe bbox is under 44
non_findings.value: strict: 4 instances, 1 distinct (path.setup-pipe.layout-match 60.2x10.7); with the exception: 0

non_findings.claim: The 2 px shared ink of text '2' x '3' at 375 px is a harness gap, not a card defect
non_findings.value: 4 instances, also in a cell the CI lane already runs; Liberation Sans is absent on macOS, so the text fell back to Arial

leads.what: p9Grid always calls measure(false), so the 44 px coarse floor is never applied in CI. The target rule uses getBoundingClientRect, which cannot see a stroked SVG path's real hit band. On the coarse floor it also keeps the 24 px spacing exception.
